integrity: Analytic universal proof and self-contained independent finite enumeration supplied; no claim of outside validation.
scientific_limitations: Exact one-step two-active-diagonal-mode Rademacher sketch only; wrong-sign probability is not the complete residual-amplification probability; generic rotations, multi-step convergence and floating-point stability are unproved. Historical priority cannot be guaranteed.
title: A sharp binomial phase law for wrong-sign Rademacher Krylov steps
